newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-RECORD SIGNING BARMBY MAKES IMPRESSIVE EVERTON DEBUT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RECORD SIGNING BARMBY MAKES IMPRESSIVE EVERTON DEBUT.

text.p: Gary McAllister's 68th minute goal in the 1-1 draw with Everton on Monday presented Coventry with only their second away point of the season.
McAllister cancelled out the opener by Graham Stuart from the penalty spot on the stroke of halftime.
Everton's goal came courtesy of 5.75 million pounds ($9.42 million) record signing Nick Barmby, whose shot was handled by Kevin Richardson.
Former Middlesbrough player Barmby could have marked his debut with a first-half hat-trick but he faded in the second half.
Everton had enough chances early on to have put the game beyond Coventry. But for prolonged spells in the second half they were under pressure, although both sides had chances to win.
Barmby almost made the scoresheet after two minutes when Paul Telfer carelessly lost possession.
Telfer then diverted the ball to safety as Barmby waited to pounce after a shot from Andrei Kanchelskis had been beaten out.
Gary Speed saw his shot deflected into the air and Coventry goalkeeper Steve Ogrizovic made a marvellous point-blank save from a Barmby header.
Barmby should have put Everton further ahead after being released by Kanchelskis only to delay his shot and Coventry managed to scramble the ball away.
McAllister then stunned the home fans with the equaliser with a swerving shot from the edge of the area but took a slight deflection off Gary Speed.
